content:
Apple just dropped a playful new iPhone 18 Pro Max ad that touts the model’s “longest battery life ever in an iPhone.”

The ad spot features a burgundy iPhone 18 Pro Max sort of mysteriously being used all day by a cyclops toy figure.

The minute-long clip shows off the variable aperture camera and much more. Eventually, the toy’s batteries seemingly expire before the iPhone after an eventful day of busy usage.
